sources.role: official build, config, input and media documentation

paths.path: memu.cfg or memu0.cfg beside the executable; a config is a line-oriented command file.
paths.naming: Options such as -disk-dir, -tape-dir, -rom and -kbd-remap are persisted.

paths.path: -joy enables Linux /dev/input/js0 or SDL joystick support; -joy-buttons accepts a key-matrix mapping and -joy-central sets dead-zone percentage.
paths.naming: Joystick config-save code is disabled under #if 0 in config.c; no persistent controller profile.

paths.path: Guest files inside configured disk/tape/silicon-disk images; MEMU has no universal game-save sidecar.
paths.naming: Guest filesystem naming inside the selected media image; no universal host-side save filename.

paths.path: memu.sna in the process working directory by default, or the path passed to -sna-file <file>. F9+s saves and F9+l loads the snapshot.
paths.naming: 48K ZX Spectrum .sna format, exactly 49179 bytes (27-byte header plus 49152-byte RAM dump); available only when Spectrum support is compiled and IOBYTE is 0x80.

paths.path: ROM files are explicit -romN paths, commonly under the configured roms directory (e.g. boot-type07.rom and sdx-type07.rom).
memu.cfg or memu0.cfg beside the executable.
-joy uses DirectInput; -joy-buttons is launch-only because config persistence is disabled.
Guest files inside configured disk/tape images.
paths.naming: Guest filesystem naming inside the selected media image; no universal host-side save filename.

paths.path: memu.sna in the process working directory by default, or the path passed to -sna-file <file>. F9+s saves and F9+l loads the snapshot.
paths.naming: 48K ZX Spectrum .sna format, exactly 49179 bytes (27-byte header plus 49152-byte RAM dump); available only when Spectrum support is compiled and IOBYTE is 0x80.

paths.path: Configured -romN files; no universal BIOS checksum.

linux-flatpak.reason: No official Flatpak package or manifest.

macos.reason: Official documentation names Linux and Windows builds; no macOS build was verified.

notes: No native controller writer is implemented because MEMU's own config saver excludes joystick options. Runtime and host-device identity remain unverified.
